changelog: Post-play fixes: Play and Play Next Episode now start the next title (by the server's PlayNow, which also stopped working after a server restart until the page was reloaded). A film's trailer now plays with sound as the credits' music fades out, with mute and volume at the lower right, and after 30 seconds the credits leave the screen. A back arrow at the top left leaves the player.
